profile.summary: The developer 'ghost' demonstrates **senior-level expertise** in JavaScript, specializing in **Axios HTTP client development** with a strong focus on **Node.js backend systems**. Their contributions span **HTTP protocol internals**, **asynchronous programming patterns**, and **testing methodologies**, with particular attention to **backward compatibility** (e.g., IE11 support) and **modular design**. While primarily working with Axios, their contributions reveal deep knowledge of **Node.js networking**, **proxy configurations**, and **testing framework upgrades**. The developer shows proficiency in **functional programming** (array transformations, object manipulation) and **API extensibility** (fetch adapters, public API design). Their work suggests a **senior engineer** capable of handling complex HTTP client challenges, though their frontend framework experience is limited to Axios integration rather than direct framework work (e.g., React/Vue).
